what:
eval_ab.py OLD NEW OUT.json [ROUNDS]: evaluations before and after the se_e2_a kernels that look the tables up.

Two builds of omnimd-native-gpu-eval, alternated in ROUNDS rounds (5) in one session, the order reversed every
other round; the build before runs twice a round (`before` and `before again`), so that the two show what the
machine adds. The least time of each is kept, and the median recorded. Cases: the trained HAP se_e2_a model on the
three HAP frames of the engine benchmarks and on the 88-atom frame replicated to 704, 2,376 and 5,632 atoms, and the
water se_e2_a model on frames of 192, 1,536 and 12,288 atoms, all in float32 with tables (where the build after looks
the tables up by default). Controls on paths the change leaves as they were (the build after reads stored values
there): HAP 88 and 5,632 and water 1,536 in float64 with tables, and water 1,536 in float64 with the exact nets.
And cases with the build after held to the other way (`--inline-tables`): float32 reading stored values (HAP 5,632),
and float64 looking the tables up (HAP 88 and 5,632, water 192).

builds.before: omnimd-native-gpu-eval of 0e57a4f (shawn_dev before this change, run/prev-0e57a4f)
builds.after: omnimd-native-gpu-eval of this change (branch fused-table), built 2026-11-21 17:58; the commit has the same code but for documentation and a test-only fix after the build

us_per_evaluation.case: held: HAP 5,632, float32 with tables, stored
held: HAP 5,632, float64 with tables, looked up
held: HAP 88, float64 with tables, looked up
held: water 192, float64 with tables, looked up
